assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create one complete original text-free 3:2 landscape illustration, 1536x1024 if available, for a fictional Quantara storybook. Character continuity: a huge friendly brass automaton with dark charcoal-blue armored plates traced with fine antique-gold filigree, round glowing cyan eyes, and a prominent faceted sapphire-blue communication crystal in the center of its chest. Its companion is a stout dwarven master craftsman, dark braided beard with brass clasps, goggles on forehead, rolled ivory sleeves, navy mantle, leather apron. Premium painterly fantasy book art, tactile brass and parchment, warm amber light with blue maritime daylight, subtle visual humor from earnest interactions, clear expressive poses. Fictional medieval coastal workshop city Deltaris with stone arches and a distant central communication tower. Not a UI or chart, no readable text, labels, logos, watermark, graphs, modern screens or interface. Natural scene edges, not a framed poster. Keep all main faces, hands and crystal fully in frame, no anatomy errors. Scene: at the open arch of the workshop overlooking the harbor, the craftsman studies a small wooden model of a future foundry expansion resting on a large workbench, while the automaton leans toward a tiny delivery cart of freshly baked crescent pastries beside a small hourglass. One hand points earnestly toward the long building plan, the other delicately holds a single pastry over a waiting plate. The blue chest gem is lit as if receiving a question from the distant tower. The comic disagreement is about the long building schedule versus getting pastries delivered before they cool. Compose a calm mid-wide three-quarter view, central friendship, sunlit harbor visible to one side. No speech bubbles or text.
